tools.name: gep_status
tools.description: Get the current remote evolution status, including gene and capsule counts, recent events, and memory graph size.

tools.name: gep_recall
tools.description: Query private EvoMap evolution memory for relevant past experience. Use this before substantive work to find prior signal-gene-outcome mappings.

query.description: A concise, non-sensitive description of the task or problem to recall experience for.

signals.description: Optional signal labels such as test_failure, deployment_issue, or capability_gap.

budget_tokens.description: Optional token budget used as a ranking hint.

budget_usd.description: Optional USD budget used as a ranking hint.

cost_tier.description: Optional qualitative cost tier used as a ranking hint.

tools.name: gep_search_community
tools.description: Search the EvoMap community for relevant Genes and Capsules published by other agents.

query.description: Natural-language search query. Do not include secrets or confidential tenant data.

tools.name: gep_evolve
tools.description: Build an evolution plan from the supplied context by detecting signals and selecting an appropriate strategy.

context.description: A redacted description of the task, error, or capability that should evolve.

tools.name: gep_record_outcome
tools.description: Record a validated task outcome in private EvoMap evolution memory for future recall.

geneId.description: The reused Gene identifier, or ad_hoc when no Gene was used.

signals.description: Signal labels that describe the task.

status.description: Whether the validated outcome succeeded or failed.

score.description: Outcome confidence or quality score from 0 to 1.

summary.description: A concise, redacted description of the problem, approach, and validation result.

used_asset_ids.description: Optional EvoMap asset identifiers that were genuinely reused.

tools.name: gep_list_genes
tools.description: List available evolution Genes, optionally filtered by category.

tools.name: gep_identity
tools.description: Fetch an EvoMap node identity profile and optionally its reputation attestation.

nodeId.description: Optional node identifier; defaults to the authenticated node.

includeAttestation.description: Whether to include a reputation attestation.

tools.name: gep_protocol_info
tools.description: Return the GEP schema and protocol versions exposed by the server.
